question_en: The whole Star Trek universe, movies and series, oldest first
question_fr: L'ensemble de l'univers Star Trek, films et séries, du plus ancien au plus récent
translation_note: Each evaluation carries an English (`question_en`) and a French (`question_fr`) form. One side is the original input typed by the user; the other is automatically translated by gpt-4o through Phase 5 (EN→FR) or Phase 6 (FR→EN) of the evaluator. Translations are generally high-quality but may differ in wording from a natively-typed equivalent — keep this in mind when comparing API outputs across languages.
assertion_refresh_sql:
SELECT t.ID_CONTENT, t.CONTENT_TYPE FROM (
  SELECT T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE AS ID_CONTENT, 'movie' AS CONTENT_TYPE, T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.DAT_RELEASE AS DAT_FIRST_AIR
  FROM T_WC_T2S_MOVIE
  JOIN T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_COLLECTION ON T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_COLLECTION.ID_MOVIE
  JOIN T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION ON T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.ID_T2S_COLLECTION = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_COLLECTION.ID_T2S_COLLECTION
  WHERE T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.COLLECTION_NAME = 'Star Trek Collection'
  UNION
  SELECT T_WC_T2S_SERIE.ID_SERIE AS ID_CONTENT, 'serie' AS CONTENT_TYPE, T_WC_T2S_SERIE.DAT_FIRST_AIR
  FROM T_WC_T2S_SERIE
  JOIN T_WC_T2S_SERIE_COLLECTION ON T_WC_T2S_SERIE.ID_SERIE = T_WC_T2S_SERIE_COLLECTION.ID_SERIE
  JOIN T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION ON T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.ID_T2S_COLLECTION = T_WC_T2S_SERIE_COLLECTION.ID_T2S_COLLECTION
  WHERE T_WC_T2S_COLLECTION.COLLECTION_NAME = 'Star Trek Collection'
) AS t
ORDER BY t.DAT_FIRST_AIR ASC
